response.summary: If Lotus Peak delivers later than the agreed 6‑day delivery window, the Buyer may deduct 0.5% of the order value for each day of delay, up to a maximum of 5% of the order value.

reasons.statement: The Supplier must deliver within 6 calendar days of receiving a purchase order; for each day of late delivery the Buyer may deduct 0.5% of the order value, up to 5%.

sources.title: Lotus Peak supply agreement
sources.text: Prices are fixed in Indian rupees until 31 March 2027 and exclude GST. The Supplier will deliver within 6 calendar days of receiving a purchase order. For each day of late delivery the Buyer may deduct 0.5% of the order value, up to 5%. Laptops carry a 24-month on-site warranty. Faulty units must be replaced within 3 working days.
